purpose: Transfer stress tests, not optimization for repeating the 25 validation hits.
unlabelled_test_usage: The structural distance audit motivated the <=0.36 anchor-similarity stress gate. No activity outcomes were used.

definitions.J: Fresh candidates ranked against crystal ligand 47 only, using frozen 65/20/15 ligand metrics and 5% DEL model contribution.
definitions.K: Fresh candidates without a quinazoline core; 30% structural Tanimoto, 45% feature Tanimoto, 25% feature Tversky, across the two ligands; 5% DEL contribution.
definitions.L: Frozen winning score on fresh candidates with maximum reference ECFP similarity <=0.36 and maximum ECFP similarity to any prior G candidate <=0.40.

caveat: These gates create harder validation experiments, but do not reproduce the organizers hidden test series or prove OOD generalization. Expected validation yield may be lower.
